channel.title: EVENTFAQS Media Pvt - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Creative Technology Renews Partnership with Nordic Business Forum for 2026 Stage Experience
item.description: Creative Technology, a global AV supplier to the live events and permanent installation markets, has renewed its partnership with Nordic Business Forum for the 2026 edition in Helsinki.

item.title: Robust Events Curates Experiential ‘Explorers’ Pavilion’ at Gypsy Travel Festival 2026
item.description: Robust Events created The Explorers’ Pavilion at the Gypsy Travel Festival 2026 in Mumbai, creating immersive brand environments for 10 travel and lifestyle participants.

item.title: Medium Healthcare Consulting and Indium Capital Advisors Announce Healthcare Leadership Forum 2026 in Mumbai
item.description: Medium Healthcare Consulting and Indium Capital Advisors have announced the launch of the Healthcare Leadership Forum 2026, set to bring together 150 senior healthcare leaders in Mumbai on 24 February.

item.title: Aadyam Theatre Launches Eighth Season in Delhi with Supernatural Thriller Ankahi
item.description: Aadyam Theatre begins its eighth season in Delhi with Ankahi, a Hindi adaptation of The Woman in Black, marking its first venture into the supernatural thriller genre.

item.title: The Sacred Rave: How MSEED’s Report Maps the Rise of Bhajan Clubbing in India
item.description: A new research report by MSEED examines how bhajan clubbing has evolved from intimate devotional gatherings into a scalable cultural and commercial force reshaping India’s experience economy.

item.title: Flipperachi to Make Mumbai Debut with Live Concert at Phoenix Marketcity on 13 March
item.description: Bahraini rapper Flipperachi will perform in Mumbai for the first time on 13 March 2026, with tickets going on sale from 14 February via District by Zomato.

item.title: YOLO Entertainment Orchestrates First-Ever Indian Wedding and Historic Sangeet at the Pyramids of Giza
item.description: YOLO Entertainment & Weddings Luxury executed the first-ever Indian Sangeet at the Pyramids of Giza and the first Indian wedding at The St. Regis New Capital, Cairo, during a four-day celebration in January 2026.

item.title: HRAWI Launches Knowledge Series in Pune to Address Key Hospitality Regulations
item.description: HRAWI will launch its Knowledge Series in Pune on February 12, focusing on DPDP rules, GST, Labour Codes and Tourism Policy, with Ernst & Young as the official knowledge partner.

item.title: John Mayer Makes India Debut with Landmark Performance in Mumbai
item.description: John Mayer performed in India for the first time in Mumbai, delivering a career-spanning set in a concert produced by BookMyShow Live.

item.title: International Luxury Travel Market Appoints One Rep Global as Official Partner in India
item.description: One Rep Global has been appointed by RX Global to manage the Indian Buyer Program across ILTM, IBTM and IGTM events, strengthening India’s presence in global travel trade platforms.
